classes.talk: small talk, a greeting, a feeling or a reply that needs no fact and no tool
classes.simple: one quick answer: a fact, a short lookup or one tool call, no deliberation
classes.complex: needs careful reasoning, planning or several steps before it can be answered
classes.research: needs a deep search over many sources before it can be answered

intents.chat: to talk, share or be heard
intents.question: to know something

needs.research: a deep search over many sources

params.script_inline:
"""The `route` cell of talky: every turn asks the decider once, the answer becomes ONE stamp.

The rule (R-WP-1 a, R-WP-9): this cell classifies a turn BEFORE the round is built and
RECOMMENDS a path; the curator decides. The classes are params (`classes`, four as
shipped: talk, simple, complex, research), so another colony asks its own route question
with the same mechanism. Without `choices` the stamp has exactly seven keys,
`{turn_id, path, p, intent, needs, families, duration}`; with them it has nine, plus
`choices` and `turn_notes` (GH #1304), and the collector's `in_route` lane reads both.

Lanes, no state: `in_turn` (the keeper's turn) leaves as one `decide` call with the
moment it was asked on the hop, and `in_decision` (the decider's answer, the moment
carried back through context by the composite's edges) leaves as one `stamp`. Unsure
(the chosen class below `threshold`), an error of the decider, or an answer later than
`late_ms`: the stamp says `fallback_class` (talk) with no needs and no families, so a
slow or broken decider costs a turn nothing but the recommendation. `unsure_families`
"1" (#1412) lets an unsure stamp keep the families the decider said yes to: they are
their own yes/no questions, which an unsure path does not touch. `stamp_needs_yes`
"1" (#1466) adds `needs_yes` to a JUDGED stamp: the yes-value of every asked need the
decider answered with a number, also of those below `yes_threshold`.

GH #1304: a product's own questions (`choices`) ride in the SAME decide call and fall
back each on its own -- an unsure path keeps them; an error, a late answer or a choice
under its own threshold gives the declared `fallback`, a value the model is never
offered, so `choices` on a stamp is never empty. A chosen value with a text under
`notes` becomes a turn note on the stamp, which the collector carries to the curate seam
of the same turn. Such a stamp leaves on `notes_class` (GH #1340): only the speaking way
of a talk turn shows turn notes. `stamp_out` "1" sends the stamp a second time, as `stamp_out`, without
text and without the notes, for the composite's rim. `context_turns` above 0 first asks
the curator for a view WITHOUT a target (`view_ask`, answered on `in_view`: the person's
last turns as `messages`) and puts them in a block before the turn; the turn's text rides
out and back on the hop.

FU2 (#1279), all off as shipped. `judge_context` "1" orders a view for the target the param
`view_target` names (D58 GH #1480; the composite sets it, the cell has no built-in name)
and folds it into the decide state as before: the view's `messages` (both roles' earlier
turns), the leaves `topic` and `frame` (now and place), and the leaves of the target's
family that `view_sources` names -- the screen topics and the person's how-questions.
`./decide` takes no window (provider `decisions`), so the view is folded here, byte for
byte the text of before. When the screen leaf holds topics,
the SAME decide call asks the screen question (`screen.topic` over every topic
plus `none`, one `screen.lead` and one `screen.further` over the candidates of all
topics as `<topic>/<key>` -- the call does not grow with the topics, #1371), and the
stamp carries `screen {topic, confidence, lead,
further}` -- never for `clarify`, never under `threshold`, never on `none`. The lead
belongs to the chosen topic (#1412). A product
choice named `screen_form` also stands on the stamp as `stamp.screen_form`. A turn with
`context.delta` "1" (a partial of a voice call) asks the wall like a turn (live-2 #1369:
the curator answers a delta from the round's newest rows, the call has no generation
yet), its text rides out and back, and its stamp leaves as `delta_stamp` for the curator
with `text_norm`, never for the collector or the rim.
"""

import json
import sys
import time

# >>> content-budget v1 (R-IG-1, GH #1085)
CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 3


def budget_chars(input_soft, share):
    """Characters a producer may hand a model whose usable window is
    `input_soft` tokens (the catalog row, cut by the curator), for a section
    that takes `share` of that window. None when no window is known: the
    producer then delivers its content whole."""
    try:
        soft = int(float(input_soft))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    if soft <= 0:
        return None
    return int(soft * share * CHARS_PER_TOKEN)


def clip(text, limit, hint="budget of the window"):
    """`text` whole when it fits `limit` (None: no limit); else its head and
    a mark naming what was shown, the total and how to get the rest."""
    text = "" if text is None else str(text)
    if limit is None or len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    limit = max(0, int(limit))
    return text[:limit] + "...[cut: %d of %d chars shown; %s]" % (
        limit, len(text), hint)
# <<< content-budget v1

# >>> token-estimate v1 (GH #1098)
# The one token estimate of the templates: a request as the llm cell
# estimates it before it refuses one over `input_hard` (`window.rs`
# `estimate_prompt_tokens`) for a model whose catalogue row states no rates
# of its own -- UTF-8 bytes of every string and object key, 4 for a number
# or a bool, over CHARS_PER_TOKEN of the content-budget block (the same
# three bytes a token every budget of the templates is sized with), rounded
# up; a string starting `data:` (an inline image) counts IMAGE_TOKENS, the
# cell's own `llm::window::IMAGE_TOKENS`.
IMAGE_TOKENS = 1024


def estimate_tokens(value):
    """Tokens of `value` (any JSON value) by the rule above."""
    nbytes, images, todo = 0, 0, [value]
    while todo:
        v = todo.pop()
        if isinstance(v, str):
            if v.startswith("data:"):
                images += 1
            else:
                nbytes += len(v.encode("utf-8"))
        elif isinstance(v, dict):
            for k, x in v.items():
                nbytes += len(str(k).encode("utf-8"))
                todo.append(x)
        elif isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
            todo.extend(v)
        elif isinstance(v, (bool, int, float)):
            nbytes += 4
    return tokens_of_bytes(nbytes) + images * IMAGE_TOKENS


def tokens_of_bytes(nbytes):
    """Tokens of `nbytes` bytes (or characters) of text: over
    CHARS_PER_TOKEN, rounded up."""
    return -(-max(0, int(nbytes)) // CHARS_PER_TOKEN)
# <<< token-estimate v1

# Small deciders have a 32k window; the decide model's window is small, so the
# block of earlier turns is bounded hard, whatever a product sets.
CONTEXT_BUDGET_CAP = 4000
CONTEXT_BUDGET_DEFAULT = 1500

# The screen question (FU-0, the presenter's own question form): `none` is a topic
# and a second block like any other, and the model may pick it.
NONE = "none"
NONE_TOPIC = "nothing on the screen helps with this request"
NONE_FURTHER = "no second block"
LEAD_SEP = "/"
# The class that asks the person back: it never puts anything on the screen.
CLARIFY = "clarify"
CLARIFY_DEFAULT = ("the request is ambiguous: how it is meant stays open even with the "
                   "earlier conversation, so the person has to be asked back first")


def switch_on(v):
    """One switch (#1370): JSON true, "1", "true" or "on" is on, anything else
    off -- the rule of the presenter's `knob()`. A set writes its switches as
    JSON true (soul2me 0.45 `04-assistant.json`), and `str(True)` is "True":
    a read `== "1"` kept them off without a word."""
    return str(v).strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "on")


def classes_of(params):
    """The classes the path question offers. `clarify` only with the knob `clarify` "1"
    (#1279): off, a `clarify` under `classes` is not asked; on, it is asked with
    its own description, or with `CLARIFY_DEFAULT` when `classes` names none."""
    classes = options(params, "classes")
    if switch_on(params.get("clarify")):
        classes.setdefault(CLARIFY, CLARIFY_DEFAULT)
    else:
        classes.pop(CLARIFY, None)
    return classes


# What the end of a text may lose before two texts are compared (route and the
# curator's policy cut the same way).
TRAILING = ".!?…,;: \t\r\n"


def normalize(text):
    """The text as it is compared: one space between words, lower case, no trailing
    punctuation or space."""
    return " ".join(str(text or "").split()).lower().rstrip(TRAILING)


def now_ms():
    return int(time.time() * 1000)


def emission(route, body, **header):
    head = {"route": route}
    head.update(header)
    out = {"header": head, "messages": []}
    out.update(body)
    return out


def text_of(body):
    said = []
    for m in body.get("messages") or []:
        if isinstance(m, dict) and m.get("type", "text") == "text" \
                and m.get("origin", "user") != "assistant" \
                and isinstance(m.get("text"), str):
            said.append(m["text"])
    return " ".join(s for s in said if s.strip()).strip()


def options(params, key):
    v = params.get(key)
    if isinstance(v, str):
        try:
            v = json.loads(v)
        except ValueError:
            v = None
    if not isinstance(v, dict):
        return {}
    return {str(k): str(d) for k, d in v.items() if isinstance(k, str) and k}


def number(params, key, default):
    v = params.get(key)
    if isinstance(v, bool) or not isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        try:
            v = float(v)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return default
    return float(v)


def product_choices(params):
    """The product's choices that can be asked: a question, two options or more and a
    fallback OUTSIDE the options. A choice that is none of this is not asked and not
    stamped -- the decisions wire refuses a one-option choice with `decide_invalid`,
    and with it the whole call, and a fallback the model may pick is no fallback."""
    v = params.get("choices")
    if isinstance(v, str):
        try:
            v = json.loads(v)
        except ValueError:
            v = None
    out = {}
    if not isinstance(v, dict):
        return out
    for name, c in sorted(v.items()):
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not isinstance(c, dict):
            continue
        opts = options(c, "options")
        fallback = c.get("fallback")
        if len(opts) < 2 or not isinstance(fallback, str) or not fallback \
                or fallback in opts or not isinstance(c.get("question"), str):
            continue
        out[name] = {"question": c["question"], "options": opts, "fallback": fallback,
                     "threshold": c.get("threshold"), "notes": options(c, "notes")}
    return out


def judge_on(params):
    return switch_on(params.get("judge_context"))


def view_target(params):
    """D58 GH #1480: the target this cell orders its view for -- the param `view_target`,
    no built-in name (R-58-15); "" orders a view without a target."""
    target = params.get("view_target")
    return target.strip() if isinstance(target, str) else ""


def leaf_text(tree, *path):
    """The text of the leaf at `path` of a view's system tree, "" when there is none."""
    node = tree
    for name in path:
        node = node.get(name) if isinstance(node, dict) and name else None
    text = node.get("text") if isinstance(node, dict) else None
    return text if isinstance(text, str) else ""


def leaf_data(tree, *path):
    """A structured leaf read back from its JSON text (the curator keeps a structured
    contribution as its JSON text, unread); None when there is none or it is no JSON."""
    text = leaf_text(tree, *path)
    try:
        return json.loads(text) if text else None
    except ValueError:
        return None


def frame_facts(text):
    """The leaf `frame` of a view: one `<name>: <value>` fact per line (now, weekday,
    timezone, place; OR-d58-2.judge.8)."""
    facts = {}
    for line in text.split("\n"):
        name, sep, value = line.partition(":")
        if sep:
            facts[name.strip()] = value[1:] if value.startswith(" ") else value
    return facts


def kept_topics(value):
    """The screen topics of the screen leaf in the form the curator kept them before D58
    (`{name, purpose, candidates?: [{key, describe}]}`, names and keys stripped, each
    name once, an absent purpose or describe ""): the curator no longer reads the value,
    and the decide text and questions stay the bytes they were."""
    out, seen = [], set()
    for t in value if isinstance(value, list) else []:
        name = str(t.get("name") or "").strip() if isinstance(t, dict) else ""
        if not name or name in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(name)
        topic = {"name": name, "purpose": str(t.get("purpose") or "")}
        cands = t.get("candidates")
        if isinstance(cands, list):
            topic["candidates"] = [
                {"key": str(c.get("key") or "").strip(), "describe": str(c.get("describe") or "")}
                for c in cands if isinstance(c, dict) and str(c.get("key") or "").strip()]
        out.append(topic)
    return out


def view_context(body, params, hop=None):
    """D58 GH #1480: the judge context out of a view -- `messages` as the turns, the
    leaves `topic` and `frame`, and the leaves of the target's family that the param
    `view_sources` names (`screen`: the screen topics, `hints`: the person's how-
    questions); None for a view without a system tree (a view without a target).
    The screen is held whenever the view is (no screen state reaches the curator, so
    the decide text says "- nothing" as it always did).

    A refused or degraded view (`hop.refused`, `hop.degraded`) is no judge context
    (review I1): without the leaf `frame` (the refusal at the curator's door) it gives
    None, the turn alone, as the turns ask without a package did; with it the moment
    alone, as the package of now and place without turns, topic or screen did -- the
    text stays the bytes it was in both places."""
    system = body.get("system")
    if not isinstance(system, dict):
        return None
    hop = hop if isinstance(hop, dict) else {}
    if hop.get("refused") or hop.get("degraded"):
        if not leaf_text(system, "frame"):
            return None
        body, system = {}, {"frame": system["frame"]}
    sources = params.get("view_sources") if isinstance(params.get("view_sources"), dict) else {}
    target = view_target(params)
    turns = [{"role": str(m.get("origin") or ""), "text": m.get("text")}
             for m in body.get("messages") or []
             if isinstance(m, dict) and m.get("type", "text") == "text"]
    frame = frame_facts(leaf_text(system, "frame"))
    hints = leaf_data(system, target, str(sources.get("hints") or ""))
    return {"turns": turns, "topic": leaf_text(system, "topic"),
            "hints": hints if isinstance(hints, list) else [],
            "screen": {"topics": kept_topics(
                leaf_data(system, target, str(sources.get("screen") or "")))},
            "now": {k: frame.get(n, "") for k, n in
                    (("iso", "now"), ("weekday", "weekday"), ("timezone", "timezone"))},
            "place": frame.get("place", "")}


def screen_topics(judge):
    """The topics of the judge context's screen (the screen leaf of the view) that can be
    asked: a name that is not `none` and a purpose, each name once; candidates
    `{key: describe}`."""
    screen = judge.get("screen") if isinstance(judge, dict) else None
    topics = screen.get("topics") if isinstance(screen, dict) else None
    out = {}
    for t in topics if isinstance(topics, list) else []:
        if not isinstance(t, dict):
            continue
        name, purpose = t.get("name"), t.get("purpose")
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or name == NONE or name in out \
                or not isinstance(purpose, str):
            continue
        cands = {}
        for c in t.get("candidates") if isinstance(t.get("candidates"), list) else []:
            if isinstance(c, dict) and isinstance(c.get("key"), str) and c["key"] \
                    and c["key"] != NONE and isinstance(c.get("describe"), str):
                cands.setdefault(c["key"], c["describe"])
        out[name] = {"purpose": purpose, "candidates": cands}
    return out


def screen_option(topic, key):
    """One candidate as an option of the flat screen questions (#1371)."""
    return topic + LEAD_SEP + key


def screen_questions(judge):
    """FU-0: `screen.topic` over every topic plus `none`; ONE `screen.lead` over the
    candidates of every topic with two or more, ONE `screen.further` over the candidates
    of every topic with one or more plus `none`, each candidate as `<topic>/<key>`
    (#1371: three questions however many topics a screen has -- per topic, 23 topics
    asked 70 and the decisions wire refuses more than 64). A choice of one option is
    never asked."""
    topics = screen_topics(judge)
    if not topics:
        return {}
    qs = {}
    opts = {name: t["purpose"] for name, t in sorted(topics.items())}
    opts[NONE] = NONE_TOPIC
    qs["screen.topic"] = {
        "kind": "choice",
        "instructions": "Which of these would help on a screen beside the answer to this request?",
        "options": opts}
    lead, further = {}, {}
    for name, t in sorted(topics.items()):
        cands = t["candidates"]
        for key, describe in cands.items():
            option = "%s: %s" % (name, describe)
            if len(cands) > 1:
                lead[screen_option(name, key)] = option
            further[screen_option(name, key)] = option
    if len(lead) > 1:
        qs["screen.lead"] = {
            "kind": "choice",
            "instructions": "Which block of the topic that would help shows best what the request asks about?",
            "options": lead}
    if further:
        further[NONE] = NONE_FURTHER
        qs["screen.further"] = {
            "kind": "choice",
            "instructions": "Which second block of that same topic helps beside the first one, if any?",
            "options": further}
    return qs


def screen_key(answer, topic):
    """The candidate key of a flat screen answer when it belongs to `topic`, else ""."""
    head = topic + LEAD_SEP
    return answer[len(head):] if answer and answer.startswith(head) else ""


def bound_lead(answers, topic):
    """The lead of the chosen `topic` (#1412). live-2 r2b T5 fu0:5: the flat lead question
    named a block of another topic and the stamp carried `lead ""` without a word. The
    decider's lead stands when it belongs to `topic`; else the block of `topic` with the
    most weight in the lead's distribution (`p` per option, the decisions wire's form),
    the first by name on equal weight; "" when no block of `topic` has weight -- the
    presenter's standard leads then (the standard never reaches this cell), nothing is
    made up."""
    lead = screen_key(choice_of(answers, "screen.lead")[0], topic)
    if lead:
        return lead
    a = answers.get("screen.lead")
    dist = a.get("p") if isinstance(a, dict) else None
    best, top = "", 0.0
    for option in sorted(dist) if isinstance(dist, dict) else []:
        w = dist[option]
        key = screen_key(option, topic)
        if key and key != NONE and not isinstance(w, bool) \
                and isinstance(w, (int, float)) and w > top:
            best, top = key, float(w)
    return best


def screen_of(params, answers, path):
    """The screen verdict of a judged decide call, or None: no topic, `none`, a topic
    under `threshold` or a `clarify` path stamp no screen. Without candidates (or
    without an answer for them) `lead`/`further` stay "" -- the presenter takes its
    own standard then. The lead is bound to the topic (`bound_lead`); a further of
    another topic stays "" (#1412)."""
    if not judge_on(params) or path == CLARIFY or not isinstance(answers, dict) \
            or "screen.topic" not in answers \
            or choice_of(answers, "path")[0] == CLARIFY:
        return None
    topic, p = choice_of(answers, "screen.topic")
    if not topic or topic == NONE or p < number(params, "threshold", 0.6):
        return None
    lead = bound_lead(answers, topic)
    further = screen_key(choice_of(answers, "screen.further")[0], topic)
    lead = lead if lead and lead != NONE else ""
    further = further if further and further != NONE and further != lead else ""
    return {"topic": topic, "confidence": p, "lead": lead, "further": further}


def questions(params, judge=None):
    """`path` over the classes; `intent` over the intents; one yes/no per need and family;
    one choice per product choice (`choices.<name>`, GH #1304); the screen question
    when the judge context carries topics (#1279).

    A choice needs two options (the decisions wire refuses one with `decide_invalid`,
    and with it the whole call), so a list of fewer than two is not asked."""
    qs = {}
    classes = classes_of(params)
    if len(classes) >= 2:
        qs["path"] = {"kind": "choice",
                      "instructions": "Which way should this request be answered?",
                      "options": classes}
    intents = options(params, "intents")
    if len(intents) >= 2:
        qs["intent"] = {"kind": "choice",
                        "instructions": "What does the person want with this request?",
                        "options": intents}
    for name, describe in sorted(options(params, "needs").items()):
        qs["needs." + name] = {"kind": "yes_no",
                               "instructions": "Does answering it need %s?" % describe}
    for name, describe in sorted(options(params, "families").items()):
        qs["families." + name] = {"kind": "yes_no",
                                  "instructions": "Would answering it use %s?" % describe}
    for name, c in product_choices(params).items():
        qs["choices." + name] = {"kind": "choice", "instructions": c["question"],
                                 "options": c["options"]}
    if judge is not None and judge_on(params):
        qs.update(screen_questions(judge))
    return qs


def choice_of(answers, key):
    a = answers.get(key) if isinstance(answers, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(a, dict) or not isinstance(a.get("choice"), str):
        return None, 0.0
    p = a.get("p")
    if isinstance(p, dict):
        p = p.get(a["choice"])
    if isinstance(p, bool) or not isinstance(p, (int, float)):
        p = 0.0
    return a["choice"], float(p)


def yes_of(answers, key):
    a = answers.get(key) if isinstance(answers, dict) else None
    y = a.get("yes") if isinstance(a, dict) else None
    if isinstance(y, bool) or not isinstance(y, (int, float)):
        return 0.0
    return float(y)


def needs_yes(params, answers):
    """GH #1466: the yes-values of the asked needs, `{<need>: yes}`, for a judged stamp;
    None with `stamp_needs_yes` off (shipped: the stamp of before). `needs` names only
    what reached `yes_threshold`, and `p` is the confidence of the PATH: neither tells
    a yes of 0.45 from one of 0.02, and the curator leaves a fetched recall out of the
    window only for a turn that SURELY needs no memory (`recall_skip_sure`). A need
    the decider did not answer with a number is absent, never 0 (`yes_of` reads it as
    0.0 for the threshold) -- silence must not read as a sure no."""
    if not switch_on(params.get("stamp_needs_yes")):
        return None
    out = {}
    for n in sorted(options(params, "needs")):
        a = answers.get("needs." + n) if isinstance(answers, dict) else None
        y = a.get("yes") if isinstance(a, dict) else None
        if isinstance(y, (int, float)) and not isinstance(y, bool):
            out[n] = float(y)
    return out


def choice_values(params, answers, usable):
    """Every product choice gets a value: the model's, when it chose an option at or
    above the choice's threshold (default: the route `threshold`) and the answer is
    `usable`; otherwise the declared fallback. Never empty for a choice that was asked.
    The notes of the values the model chose, as turn notes (`priority` 0, the highest)."""
    values, notes = {}, []
    default = number(params, "threshold", 0.6)
    for name, c in product_choices(params).items():
        value, p = choice_of(answers, "choices." + name) if usable else (None, 0.0)
        bar = number(c, "threshold", default)
        if value in c["options"] and p >= bar:
            values[name] = {"value": value, "p": p, "source": "model"}
            text = c["notes"].get(value, "")
            if text.strip():
                notes.append({"id": "route." + name, "source": "route." + name,
                              "text": text, "scope": "turn", "priority": 0})
        else:
            values[name] = {"value": c["fallback"], "p": 0.0, "source": "fallback"}
    return values, notes


def steer(params, path, p, choices, notes):
    """GH #1340: a stamp with notes leaves on `notes_class`, whatever path the decider
    named. The curator shows turn notes on the `brain` way only -- the quick role's
    `notes_share` is 0, and a consult or research turn is spoken to first by the quick
    bridge, whose window is the person's turn plus `instructions.bridge`. Measured on a
    canary colony (meclaw 0.76.2): `choices.risk` acute (p 1.0) with `path` complex
    (p 0.67) let the bridge speak first without the note -- no emergency number -- and
    the note's guidance came a round later through the consult. `p` becomes the highest
    `p` of the choices that set a note; the hop names them. Returns `(path, p, steered)`;
    `notes_class` "" or a class not asked keeps the decider's path."""
    target = str(params.get("notes_class") or "")
    if not notes or not target or target == path \
            or target not in classes_of(params):
        return path, p, ""
    ids = [n["id"] for n in notes]
    ps = [c["p"] for name, c in (choices or {}).items()
          if "route." + name in ids and c.get("source") == "model"]
    return target, (max(ps) if ps else p), ",".join(ids)


def has_round(value):
    """A round is an audience set: a list, or the JSON text of one. `[]` is a round
    (the person alone); absent, empty or unreadable is none."""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            value = json.loads(value)
        except ValueError:
            return False
    return isinstance(value, list)


def stamp(ctx, params, turn_id, path, p, intent, needs, families, duration,
          fallback="", choices=None, notes=None, steered="", screen=None, yes=None):
    """The stamp, plus its rim copy under `stamp_out`. A fallback stamp carries `p` 0
    (no confidence stands behind the fallback class) and says why on the hop, never
    inside the keys. `choices`/`turn_notes` only when the product declared choices;
    `screen_form` only when one of them is named so, `screen` only for a judged call
    that named a topic (#1279). `needs_yes` only when the caller hands `yes` (#1466):
    a judged stamp with `stamp_needs_yes` on, never a fallback and never the rim copy."""
    head = {"turn_id": turn_id, "path": path}
    if fallback:
        head["fallback"] = fallback
    if steered:
        head["steered"] = steered
    s = {"turn_id": turn_id, "path": path, "p": p, "intent": intent, "needs": needs,
         "families": families, "duration": duration}
    if yes is not None:
        s["needs_yes"] = yes
    if product_choices(params):
        if choices is None:
            choices, _ = choice_values(params, {}, False)
        s["choices"] = choices
        s["turn_notes"] = notes or []
    extra = {}
    form = (s.get("choices") or {}).get("screen_form")
    if isinstance(form, dict) and isinstance(form.get("value"), str):
        extra["screen_form"] = form["value"]
    if screen:
        extra["screen"] = screen
    s.update(extra)
    out = [emission("stamp", {"stamp": s}, **head)]
    round_ = ctx.get("audience_set")
    if switch_on(params.get("stamp_out")) and has_round(round_):
        # The stamp for the rim (GH #1304): who, where and what was decided, never
        # what was said -- no text, no notes. The keeper's turn carries the session,
        # the channel and the round in its context. Without a round the reader
        # outside could not assign it, so no rim copy at all (fail-closed, as the
        # round is everywhere else); the stamp inside still goes.
        rim = {"turn_id": turn_id, "session_id": str(ctx.get("session_id") or ""),
               "channel": str(ctx.get("channel") or ""),
               "audience_set": round_,
               "path": path, "intent": intent, "choices": s.get("choices", {}),
               "duration": duration}
        rim.update(extra)
        rim_head = dict(head)
        if extra or switch_on(params.get("judge_context")):
            # GH #1279: a stamp that carries the screen (`screen` or `screen_form`)
            # is also the presenter's verdict; talky carries it out of its rim a second
            # time, on `verdict`, by this hop key alone. With `judge_context` on, EVERY
            # stamp is the verdict -- clarify, topic `none`, a topic under `threshold`:
            # the presenter in its stamp mode closes such a turn as `no_topic` only if
            # the stamp arrives (presenter/stage `lane_verdict`); without it the turn
            # runs into `budget_ms` and is journalled `timeout`.
            rim_head["verdict"] = "1"
        out.append(emission("stamp_out", {"stamp": rim}, **rim_head))
    return out


def of_call(hop):
    """GH #1404: the call a voice partial belongs to (`call_id`, `session_id` on its hop),
    carried on every hop of the partial so its stamp can name it."""
    return {k: str(hop[k]) for k in ("call_id", "session_id") if str(hop.get(k) or "")}


def as_delta(out, hop):
    """GH #1279: a partial's stamp is the curator's (`delta_stamp`), with the normalised text
    it was decided on; no rim copy, nothing for the collector. GH #1404: it names its call."""
    first = out[0]
    first["header"]["route"] = "delta_stamp"
    first["header"].update(of_call(hop))
    first["stamp"]["text_norm"] = normalize(hop.get("state"))
    return [first]


def lane_decision(body, hop, ctx, params, now):
    out = decided(body, hop, ctx, params, now)
    if str(ctx.get("delta") or "") == "1":
        return as_delta(out, hop)
    return out


def decided(body, hop, ctx, params, now):
    turn_id = str(ctx.get("turn_id") or hop.get("turn_id") or "")
    fallback = str(params.get("fallback_class") or "talk")
    try:
        duration = max(0, now - int(str(hop.get("asked_at"))))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        duration = 0
    if hop.get("finish_reason") == "error" or hop.get("error_code"):
        # Never silent (#1371): a refused decide call stamps the fallback and says why.
        sys.stderr.write("route: decide failed (%s), fallback stamp\n"
                         % (hop.get("error_code") or "error"))
        return stamp(ctx, params, turn_id, fallback, 0.0, "", [], [], duration, "error")
    d = body.get("decision") if isinstance(body.get("decision"), dict) else body
    answers = d.get("answers") if isinstance(d, dict) else None
    classes = classes_of(params)
    path, p = choice_of(answers, "path")
    intent, _ = choice_of(answers, "intent")
    if intent not in options(params, "intents"):
        intent = ""
    yes = number(params, "yes_threshold", 0.5)
    needs = [n for n in sorted(options(params, "needs"))
             if yes_of(answers, "needs." + n) >= yes]
    families = [f for f in sorted(options(params, "families"))
                if yes_of(answers, "families." + f) >= yes]
    late = number(params, "late_ms", 0)
    if late > 0 and duration > late:
        # Late: the round is already on its way, a note would reach no window.
        return stamp(ctx, params, turn_id, fallback, 0.0, intent, [], [], duration,
                     "late")
    # Each choice on its own (GH #1304): an unsure PATH does not touch them.
    choices, notes = choice_values(params, answers, True)
    if path not in classes or p < number(params, "threshold", 0.6):
        path, p, steered = steer(params, fallback, 0.0, choices, notes)
        # #1412 (live-2 T5-15, a running timer: `path` simple 0.53 under 0.6): the
        # families are their own yes/no questions, like the choices above; with
        # `unsure_families` on, an unsure path keeps them. The needs stay with the
        # path: the fallback way carries no tool duty.
        kept = families if switch_on(params.get("unsure_families")) else []
        return stamp(ctx, params, turn_id, path, p, intent, [], kept, duration,
                     "unsure", choices, notes, steered, screen_of(params, answers, path))
    path, p, steered = steer(params, path, p, choices, notes)
    # GH #1466: the judged stamp alone carries the yes-values; every fallback above
    # (error, late, unsure) leaves without them -- no judgement stands behind it.
    return stamp(ctx, params, turn_id, path, p, intent, needs, families, duration,
                 "", choices, notes, steered, screen_of(params, answers, path),
                 needs_yes(params, answers))


def context_block(turns, text):
    """The decide state with the person's earlier words in a block before the turn.
    The wall already cut them to the budget; no earlier words, the turn alone."""
    said = [str(t.get("text") or "").strip() for t in turns or []
            if isinstance(t, dict)]
    said = [s for s in said if s]
    if not said:
        return text
    lines = "\n".join("- " + s for s in said)
    return ("Earlier in this conversation the person said (oldest first):\n%s\n\n"
            "The request now:\n%s" % (lines, text))


def window_budget(params):
    """The tokens of the decide window's earlier context: `context_budget_tokens`,
    the budget the wall is asked to cut the turns to."""
    budget = int(number(params, "context_budget_tokens", CONTEXT_BUDGET_DEFAULT))
    if budget <= 0:
        budget = CONTEXT_BUDGET_DEFAULT
    return min(budget, CONTEXT_BUDGET_CAP)


def hints_within(lines, room):
    """GH #1363: the newest hint `lines` (newest first) that fit `room` tokens, whole;
    the older ones go whole, never half a sentence, and a cut ends on a mark naming
    what was shown and the total, like every curated block (R-IG-1)."""
    costs = [estimate_tokens(line) for line in lines]
    kept, used = [], 0
    for line, cost in zip(lines, costs):
        if used + cost > room:
            break
        kept.append(line)
        used += cost
    if len(kept) < len(lines):
        kept.append("...[cut: %d of %d hints shown, %d of %d tokens; budget of the window]"
                    % (len(kept), len(lines), used, sum(costs)))
    return kept


def judge_block(judge, text, budget):
    """GH #1279: the decide state with the judge context before the turn -- the earlier turns
    of both sides, the topic, the person's earlier how-questions, the screen, now and place.
    Facts only, each block only when the curator had it; nothing at all, the turn
    alone. GH #1363: the hints count against `budget`, beside the turns the wall
    already cut to it."""
    parts = []
    said = []
    spent = 0
    for t in judge.get("turns") if isinstance(judge.get("turns"), list) else []:
        if not isinstance(t, dict):
            continue
        words = str(t.get("text") or "").strip()
        # The wall counts a turn by its text (`newest_within`); so does the window.
        spent += estimate_tokens(str(t.get("text") or ""))
        if words:
            who = "companion" if t.get("role") == "assistant" else "person"
            said.append("- %s: %s" % (who, words))
    if said:
        parts.append("Earlier in this conversation (oldest first):\n" + "\n".join(said))
    topic = judge.get("topic")
    if isinstance(topic, str) and topic.strip():
        parts.append("The conversation is about: " + topic.strip())
    # #1279: how this person meant earlier requests -- the clarify
    # pairs the affinity keeps for them, newest first. Facts, no instruction.
    asked = []
    for h in judge.get("hints") if isinstance(judge.get("hints"), list) else []:
        if isinstance(h, dict) and isinstance(h.get("question"), str) and h["question"].strip():
            asked.append("- asked \"%s\", the person answered \"%s\" (class: %s)"
                         % (h["question"].strip(), str(h.get("answer") or "").strip(),
                            str(h.get("class") or "").strip() or "unknown"))
    if asked:
        parts.append("How this person meant earlier requests when asked (newest first):\n"
                     + "\n".join(hints_within(asked, max(0, budget - spent))))
    if isinstance(judge.get("screen"), dict):
        # D58 GH #1480: no screen state reaches the curator (master's history answered
        # `state: []` on every read), so the line names nothing, the bytes of before.
        parts.append("On the screen right now:\n- nothing")
    now = judge.get("now") if isinstance(judge.get("now"), dict) else {}
    if isinstance(now.get("iso"), str) and now["iso"]:
        when = ", ".join(str(now[k]) for k in ("weekday", "iso")
                         if isinstance(now.get(k), str) and now[k])
        tz = now.get("timezone")
        parts.append("Now: %s%s" % (when, " (%s)" % tz if isinstance(tz, str) and tz else ""))
    place = judge.get("place")
    if isinstance(place, str) and place.strip():
        parts.append("Place: " + place.strip())
    if not parts:
        return text
    return "%s\n\nThe request now:\n%s" % ("\n\n".join(parts), text)


def decide_call(params, text, asked_at, judge=None, **hop):
    return [emission("decide", {"decide": {"state": text,
                                           "questions": questions(params, judge)}},
                     asked_at=str(asked_at), **hop)]


def handle(doc):
    body = doc.get("body") or {}
    params = doc.get("params") or {}
    header = (doc.get("envelope") or {}).get("header") or {}
    hop = header.get("hop") or {}
    ctx = header.get("context") or {}
    route = str(hop.get("route") or "")
    now = now_ms()
    if route == "in_decision":
        return lane_decision(body, hop, ctx, params, now)
    turn_id = str(ctx.get("turn_id") or hop.get("turn_id") or "")
    if route == "in_turn":
        text = text_of(body)
        qs = questions(params)
        delta = str(ctx.get("delta") or "") == "1"
        if delta and (not text or "path" not in qs):
            # GH #1279: a partial without text or without a choice leaves nothing.
            return []
        if not text or "path" not in qs:
            # Nothing to ask about (a turn without text, or fewer than two classes):
            # the turn still leaves with its stamp, on the fallback, at once.
            return stamp(ctx, params, turn_id,
                         str(params.get("fallback_class") or "talk"), 0.0, "", [], [], 0,
                         "no_text")
        n = int(number(params, "context_turns", 0))
        call = of_call(hop) if delta else {}
        if n > 0 or judge_on(params):
            # The read hop counts in `late_ms`: the moment of the ask is now, and it
            # rides out and back (OR-EP-4, GH #1304). D58 GH #1480: a view, for this
            # cell's target when it judges, else without a target (the person's words).
            ask = {"turns": max(n, 0), "budget_tokens": window_budget(params)}
            if judge_on(params) and view_target(params):
                ask["target"] = view_target(params)
            return [emission("view_ask", {"view_ask": ask},
                             asked_at=str(now), state=text, **call)]
        if delta:
            # The text rides out and back for the curator's comparison (GH #1279).
            return decide_call(params, text, now, state=text, **call)
        return decide_call(params, text, now)
    if route == "in_view":
        text = str(hop.get("state") or "")
        delta = str(ctx.get("delta") or "") == "1"
        if delta and not text:
            return []
        if not text:
            return stamp(ctx, params, turn_id,
                         str(params.get("fallback_class") or "talk"), 0.0, "", [], [], 0,
                         "no_text")
        turns = body.get("messages") if isinstance(body.get("messages"), list) else []
        asked = hop.get("asked_at")
        try:
            asked = int(str(asked))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            asked = now
        judge = view_context(body, params, hop)
        # A delta's raw text rides on for the curator's comparison (`hop.state`).
        keep = dict({"state": text}, **of_call(hop)) if delta else {}
        if judge_on(params) and isinstance(judge, dict):
            return decide_call(params, judge_block(judge, text, window_budget(params)), asked, judge,
                               **keep)
        return decide_call(params, context_block(turns, text), asked, **keep)
    return []


out = handle(json.load(sys.stdin))
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out[0] if len(out) == 1 else out))

default.research: a deep search over many sources

needs.description: GH #1435: the yes/no needs the decider is asked, `{<name>: describe}`; the stamp's `needs` lists the names said yes at `yes_threshold`. Shipped: `tool`, `reasoning`, `research`. A set may add `memory` ("something the person said earlier or before today -- their people, their life, their past"): the collector then waits for the recall leg (`needs_wait_recall`) and the curator sends the turn to the brain (`memory_to_brain`).

choices.description: GH #1304: a product's own questions, asked in the SAME decide call as `path`: `{<name>: {question, options: {<option>: describe}, fallback, threshold?, notes?: {<option>: text}}}`. Two options or more, and a `fallback` OUTSIDE the options, which the model is never offered; a choice that is not so is not asked. Each choice falls back on its own: an unsure path keeps it, an error, a late answer or a choice below its `threshold` (default: `threshold`) gives `fallback`. On the stamp as `choices{<name>: {value, p, source: model|fallback}}`, never empty, plus `turn_notes`: the note of each value the model chose (`source` and `id` `route.<name>`, `scope` turn, `priority` 0). `{}` (shipped) asks nothing more and the stamp keeps its seven keys.

notes_class.description: GH #1340: the class a stamp leaves on when it carries a choice's note (`turn_notes` not empty), whatever path the decider named -- only the `brain` way shows turn notes (the quick role's `notes_share` is 0, and a consult or research turn is first spoken to by the quick bridge). The stamp's `p` is then the choice's, `hop.steered` names the notes. "" or a class not under `classes` keeps the decider's path.

stamp_out.description: GH #1304: "1" or true sends every stamp a second time as `stamp_out` -- `{turn_id, session_id, channel, audience_set, path, intent, choices, duration}`, no text and no turn notes -- which talky carries out of its rim on `stamp`. A turn without a round (no or an empty `audience_set`; `[]` is a round) raises no second stamp, fail-closed. "0" (shipped) sends nothing more; set it only where a parent draws the edge, or every turn dead-letters one message.

context_turns.description: GH #1304 (OR-EP-4): how many earlier turns OF THE PERSON, of the running generation and round, the decide call sees in a block before the turn. Above 0 the turn first orders a view without a target from the curator (`view_ask`, answered on `in_view`, D58 GH #1480; the read hop counts in `late_ms`). 0 (shipped): no read hop, the turn's text alone, as before.

context_budget_tokens.description: GH #1304: the token budget of that block; the wall drops the oldest turns first. GH #1363: the judge context's how-questions count against it too, beside the turns; the newest that fit stay whole, a cut ends on a mark. Hard cap 4000 whatever is set (the decide model's window is small, 32k); 0 or less is 1500.

judge_context.description: GH #1279: "1" or true orders a view on every turn for the target `view_target` names (D58 GH #1480: `view_ask.target`, also with `context_turns` 0, then `turns` 0) and folds it into the decide state as the judge context -- the view's `messages` (the earlier turns of both sides), the leaves `topic` and `frame` (now and place), and the leaves of the target's family that `view_sources` names (the screen topics, the person's how-questions) -- before the turn instead of the person's words alone, byte for byte the text of before (`./decide` takes no window). When the screen leaf holds topics the SAME decide call asks the screen question: `screen.topic` over every topic plus `none`, ONE `screen.lead` and ONE `screen.further` over the candidates of all topics (#1371). The stamp then carries `screen {topic, confidence, lead, further}` -- not for `none`, not under `threshold`, never on `clarify`; `lead`/`further` stay "" without candidates. "0" (shipped): no judge, no screen question, today's bytes.

view_target.description: D58 GH #1480: the target of the view this cell orders from the curator (`view_ask.target`) -- the name of the family in the view's system tree the domains contribute to for this judge. The cell has no built-in name (R-58-15): talky sets `decide` for the route and the screen judge alike, one family for the judgement of the composite (the presenter's screen topics, the collector's hints), and a composition that runs its judge on another model names that target here. "" orders a view without a target (the person's words alone).

view_sources.description: D58 GH #1480: which leaf of the target's family this cell reads for what, `{screen, hints}` -> the name of the contributing source: `screen` the screen topics (`[{name, purpose, candidates?: [{key, describe}]}]`, talky: `presenter`), `hints` the person's earlier how-questions (`[{question, answer, class}]`, talky: `affinity`). A role without a source, or a leaf that is no such list, reads as none.

clarify.description: GH #1279: "1" or true offers the class `clarify` in the path question -- with its description under `classes`, or, when `classes` names none, with a default one (the request is ambiguous and stays open even with the earlier conversation). A `clarify` stamp never carries `screen`. "0" (shipped): `clarify` is never asked, even when `classes` names it, so the path question is today's.

unsure_families.description: #1412: "1" or true lets a stamp whose `path` is unsure (the chosen class under `threshold`) keep the families the decider said yes to at `yes_threshold` or more -- they are their own yes/no questions, like the product's choices; the needs stay empty, the fallback way carries no tool duty. An error, a late answer or a turn without text still stamp no family. "0" (shipped): an unsure stamp names no family, today's bytes.

stamp_needs_yes.description: GH #1466: "1" or true adds `needs_yes` to a JUDGED stamp -- `{<need>: yes}`, the yes-value of every asked need (`needs`) the decider answered with a number, the ones below `yes_threshold` too; a need it did not answer is absent, never 0. `needs` and `p` do not tell a need that was nearly named from one that surely is none (`p` is the confidence of the path); the curator's `recall_skip_sure` reads the yes-value of `memory`. A fallback stamp (`unsure`, `late`, `error`, `no_text`) and the rim copy (`stamp_out`) never carry it. "0" (shipped): the stamp of before, today's bytes.

decide.description: the one call to `./decide`: the turn's text as `state` and the questions (`path`, `intent`, `needs.<n>`, `families.<f>`)

stamp.description: the route stamp `{turn_id, path, p, intent, needs, families, duration}` -- these seven keys, plus `choices` and `turn_notes` when the product declared `choices` (GH #1304), plus `screen_form` when one of the choices is named `screen_form` and `screen {topic, confidence, lead, further}` on a judged call that named a topic (#1279), plus `needs_yes {<need>: yes}` on a judged stamp with `stamp_needs_yes` on (#1466); on `stamp_out` the rim copy `{turn_id, session_id, channel, audience_set, path, intent, choices, duration}` (plus `screen_form`/`screen` when present), without text and notes; on `delta_stamp` the stamp of a partial plus `text_norm`, the normalised text it was decided on (#1279)

view_ask.description: D58 GH #1480 (was `turns_ask`, GH #1304): on `view_ask`, `{turns, budget_tokens, target?}` -- the view of the curator before the decide call; `target` (`view_target`) only with `judge_context` "1", without it the person's earlier words alone

asked_at.description: on `decide` and `view_ask`: the moment of the ask in ms since the epoch, carried back through context so the stamp can say how long the decider (and the read before it) took

turn_id.description: on `stamp`, `stamp_out` and `delta_stamp`: the channel turn the stamp belongs to

path.description: on `stamp`: the recommended class, the same as `stamp.path`, for an edge to test

fallback.description: on a fallback `stamp`: why it is the fallback class -- `unsure`, `error`, `late` or `no_text`; absent on a stamp the decider stands behind

verdict.description: GH #1279: "1" on a `stamp_out` whose stamp carries `screen` or `screen_form`, and with `judge_context` "1" on every `stamp_out` (clarify, topic `none` and an unsure topic included, so the presenter closes such a turn as `no_topic` instead of waiting into `timeout`); talky then carries it out of its rim a second time, on `verdict` (the presenter's `in_verdict`). Absent on every other stamp

state.description: GH #1304: on `view_ask`, the turn's text, which the composite carries out and back through context, so this cell keeps no state; GH #1279: on the `decide` call of a partial (`context.delta` "1") as well

messages.description: the keeper's turn on `in_turn`; D58 GH #1480: on `in_view`, the view's messages `{origin, type, text}`, oldest first, without the running turn

system.description: D58 GH #1480: on `in_view`, the view's system tree -- `frame` (`now`, `weekday`, `timezone`, `place`, one per line), `topic`, and the family `<view_target>` with one leaf per contributing source (`view_sources`); absent for a view without a target; read only with `judge_context` "1"

state.description: GH #1304: on `in_view`, the turn's text carried back; GH #1279: on `in_decision` of a partial, the partial's text

asked_at.description: on `in_decision` and `in_view`: the moment of the ask, carried back

description.purpose: The assistant's route cell: every turn of talky is asked ONE question set at `./decide` before the round is built, and the answer leaves as ONE route stamp `{turn_id, path, p, intent, needs, families, duration}` -- a recommendation, which the curator decides on (R-WP-1). Four classes as params: talk, simple, complex, research. A product adds its own questions (`choices`) to the same call, and may have the stamp leave the composite (`stamp_out`) and the call see the person's last turns (`context_turns`), GH #1304. GH #1279: the call can read the curator's view for its judge (`judge_context`, D58 GH #1480 `view_target`) and ask the screen question in the same call, and a partial of a voice call is stamped for the curator (`delta_stamp`).
description.use_when: Inside talky, beside the collector on the keeper's `turn`. Another composite asks its own route question by giving `classes`, `intents`, `needs` and `families` of its own.
description.not_in_scope: No decision about the round: it never holds a turn back, never picks a model and never cuts a tool menu -- the curator does. No state: the moment of the ask rides on the hop and back through context.
description.emits_meaning: route decide: the call to the decider. route stamp: the stamp, with `hop.turn_id` and `hop.path` beside it. Unsure (the chosen class below `threshold`), an error of the decider, an answer later than `late_ms` or a turn without text: `fallback_class` (talk) with `p` 0, no needs, no families, and `hop.fallback` saying which of the four it was. route stamp_out (GH #1304, only with `stamp_out` "1"): the rim copy of the stamp, no text, no notes; with `hop.verdict` "1" when it carries `screen` or `screen_form` (#1279), which talky also sends out as `verdict`. route view_ask (D58 GH #1480, was `turns_ask`; with `context_turns` above 0 or `judge_context` "1"): the view of the curator before the decide call, for `view_target` when it judges, else without a target. route delta_stamp (#1279, a turn with `context.delta` "1"): the stamp of a partial, with `text_norm`, for the curator only -- never the collector, never the rim.
description.consumes_meaning: `in_turn`: the keeper's turn (its user text is the state of the call). `in_decision`: the decider's `decision` (`answers`), or its error (`hop.finish_reason` `error` / `hop.error_code`). `in_view` (D58 GH #1480, was `in_turns`): the curator's view, the answer to `view_ask`, with the turn's text back on `hop.state`; an empty answer means the call goes on with the turn alone. GH #1279: `in_turn` with `context.delta` "1" is a partial of a voice call -- the text rides out and back on `hop.state`; `in_view` with a system tree is folded into the judge context when `judge_context` is "1".
